capabilities: list notes with source: claude-code frontmatter in a sidebar grouped by project
open a listed note by clicking it
generate a note from the current selection by spawning the CLI binary
refresh the sidebar shortly after writes via an opt-in loopback bridge
share folder pattern and port settings through .claude-notes.json
disambiguation: Not an AI note-writing tool itself; the plugin only reads and invokes notes written by the external CLI and never writes note content.
extras: Desktop only, since the generate command spawns a child process unavailable on mobile. The README discloses that the plugin can read/enumerate the vault and execute a configured shell binary, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Claude Code can write notes into the vault as plain files, but Obsidian offers no built-in way to browse them or trigger note generation from a selection.

relations.evidence: obsidian-notes-cli — writes the notes; this plugin reads them.
Claude Code plugin that shells out to the CLI.

summary: Sidebar and generate-note command for Markdown notes written into the vault by the Claude Code obsidian-notes CLI.
